unavailable: The request did not complete. Reconnect to read the durable state.
unconfirmed: Cancellation is unconfirmed. The task may still be running; reconnect before retrying.
name: Name
label: Role
uncertain: External effects may have occurred. No effect rollback or replay is claimed.
copy.independent: Each accepted invitation creates a separate copy of your Bot. Conversations, memory, secrets, connections and your computer stay with you.
copy.unavailable: This invitation or share could not be read or changed. Reconnect to check its current state.
copy.revokeNote: Revocation prevents future copies. Existing copies remain independent.
copy.credentials: Reconnect apps with your own credentials. Only plugin names are copied.
copy.declineNote: Declining closes this invitation. No copy is created. The sender can see your decision.
apps.title: Connected apps
apps.boundary: Account access is the ceiling. Each Bot also needs its own enable. Credentials and authorization links stay outside this screen.
apps.error: App or rule changes were not confirmed. Refresh to read the current state.
apps.consentNote: Choose where this app is available and when its tools ask. Authorization opens only after your explicit action.
rules.title: Tool permissions
rules.boundary: Per-Bot rules: Allow, Ask, Block. Organization rules and the account approval matrix can tighten access. Connection approval modes are separate.
hierarchyNote: Stored lead relationships only. No autonomous task dispatch or permission inheritance.
leadUnconfirmed: Lead change is unconfirmed. Reconnect to read the stored relationship, then select and save again. No automatic retry.
pending.boundary: Review what your Bot wants to do, then allow it once or deny it.
pending.error: The request was not confirmed. Refresh to read actual pending requests; no decision is automatically retried.
pending.allowed: Allowed; no longer pending. This does not confirm tool execution success.
pending.denied: Denied. Your Bot will skip this step.
pending.acknowledged: Widget acknowledged; no longer pending. No tool execution outcome is available.
pending.unconfirmed: Decision unconfirmed. Refresh pending requests before any new explicit decision.
pending.empty: No pending tool approvals in this list
pending.unlinked: No linked decision widget. Refresh to check again.
pending.auditBoundary: Policy audit only; run, deny and pause are not tool execution outcomes.
jobError.cancelled: This task was cancelled before it finished.
jobError.generic: This task did not finish. Queue it again to retry.
apps.blocked.unlisted: This Bot cannot use this app yet. Reconnect to refresh its state.
memory.title: Memory
memory.boundary: What this Bot remembers for your account. Notes fade after 48 hours. Nothing here is shared with copies.
memory.error: Memory could not be read or changed. Reconnect to check its current state.
memory.empty: This Bot has no memory entries yet.
pending.alwaysStored: Allowed always: this Bot will run this tool without asking.
pending.alwaysForbidden: Allowed once. A standing grant for this tool is not permitted, so the Bot will ask again next time.
pending.expired: This request expired or was already settled. Nothing was decided.
skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Upload a SKILL.md file. Cortex scans it before this Bot can use it.
skills.review: The scan reported {verdict}. Review what it found before enabling this skill.
skills.empty: No skills yet. Upload a SKILL.md file to add one.
skills.error.load: Skills could not be loaded. Reconnect and try again.
skills.error.file: Choose a .md file of 64 KiB or less.
skills.error.conflict: A skill with this name already exists.
skills.error.invalid: This file is not a valid skill. It needs a name and description in its frontmatter.
skills.error.upload: The skill was not uploaded. Your file was not changed; try again.
skills.error.scan: Enable this skill only after acknowledging its current scan.
skills.error.enable: The skill setting was not saved. Try again.
pending.alwaysConfirm: Always allow {tool} for this Bot? It will run without asking until you remove its approval rule.
pending.alwaysAck: I understand this grant stays until I remove it
call.title: Call {name}
call.offer: Talk with this Bot by voice. The microphone opens when you call.
call.honesty: Each sentence is recognized after you pause, then the Bot answers aloud. Words are not shown as you speak.
call.honestyStreaming: Your words appear as you speak and may change until you pause; then the Bot answers aloud.
call.endedSignedOut: Call ended because you signed out.
call.busy: Another call is already active on this account.
call.unavailable: Calls are not available on this deployment.
call.failed: The call dropped. Try calling again.
call.micDenied: Microphone access was refused. Allow it in system settings to call.
contract.takeoverConfirm: Take control of the Bot computer? The Bot stops acting until you release it.
thread.approval: I need your approval to use {tool}.
thread.waiting: {name} will reply as soon as it can.
thread.failed: {name} couldn’t finish. Send your message again to retry.
